name: Automatic controller calibration against known achievable fresh first wave

references.name: Fresh campaign first wave is achievable
references.source: Player-confirmed achievable first wave; paid early-cohort reference cleared 9/9 seeds 101–909 with 70–100 integrity, 300 ATP, no upgrades, abilities or reinforcements.

evidence.role: Establishes achievable play; scripted reference results do not count as an automatic controller passing calibration.

expectations.purpose: Validate adequate placement and reinforcement policy before drawing gameplay-balance conclusions. Failing an achievable reference identifies a controller/input mismatch.
expectations.controls: This scenario truncates the original campaign after its first authored wave; original map geometry, enemy release,300ATP and progression are preserved.
expectations.independence: Automatic controller seeds are held out from the nine paid reference seeds. The automatic base intentionally has no action script.
expectations.inference: No result automatically recommends weakening enemies, granting stats or changing economy.
